title: BIASX: “Thinking Slow” in Toxic Content Moderation with Explanations of Implied Social Biases
measurement_description: The paper evaluated the effectiveness of AI-generated explanations in helping human moderators detect subtle toxicity and hate speech. This included identifying prejudiced statements against religious groups, such as anti-Muslim and anti-Semitic content, as part of a broader set of social biases.
findings: The paper's findings are not specific to religion, but the dataset used for evaluation contained instances of religious hate speech. The general finding was that providing human moderators with free-text explanations of implied social biases (including religious ones) significantly improved their ability to correctly identify subtly toxic content, especially when the explanations were high-quality and human-written.
